Rene

Thanks for joining the list.  You say you've been reading material, but have you had a look at some of the online videos we have prepared?  Have a look at this website that contains both video lectures plus exercises analysing data:

https://workshops.distancesampling.org/online-course/

All the solutions are provided on the website, with video descriptions.  The video you can stop and rerun as often as you wish.

Have a look at those materials to get ideas about how the data are set up and how the software works.  If you still have questions, contact me directly.
